title: AI Biases as Asymmetries: A Review to Guide Practice

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptually evaluated as a violation of symmetry between a model and its representational target (i.e., when outputs or internal components do not represent reality accurately, such as sampling errors).

Conceptually evaluated as a violation of symmetry in the treatment of individuals or datapoints across different groups. The paper frames demographic fairness issues (e.g., racial bias, gender bias) within this category and evaluates them using theoretical fairness metrics like demographic parity and predictive accuracy parity.

Conceptually evaluated as a violation of symmetry between the processes by which an AI system operates and an 'ideal' set of processes (e.g., deductively valid processes or Bayesian probability). This includes theoretical evaluation of heuristics, inductive biases, and bias-variance tradeoffs.
